blocks.text: Jab dono ventricles ek saath sukar kar khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karte hain, to tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain aur “lubb” ki awaz aati hai. Isi tarah jab ventricular systole khatam hoti hai aur dono ventricles ek saath dheele hote hain, to pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hote hain aur “dubb” ki awaz aati hai. “Lubb-dubb” stethoscope ki madad se suni ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Heart murmur ka ilaj
blocks.text: Heart murmur ke zyada tar case sangeen (serious) nahin hote. Jo sangeen hon, unhen kharab valves ko masnooi (artificial) valves se, ya kisi organ donor (aza dene wale) ke valves se badal kar theek kiya ja sakta hai.

Agar valves poori tarah band na hon, ya tang (narrow) khulein, to dil ke andar khoon mein halchal (turbulence) paida hoti hai. Yeh halchal heart murmur ke taur par sunai deti hai. Murmur ki awaz seeti ya “hiss” jaisi hoti hai.
